label: Photoreal terrace
prompt: A photoreal still of an original techno wizard in an unmarked dark indigo-violet suede running coat on a tropical rooftop terrace at golden hour. Warm sidelight, palms, unmarked glass towers, empty of lettering.

label: Background swap
prompt: Keep the subject from the reference. Replace the background with a fog harbor pier at blue hour. Match ground contact and wrap light. Original character only.

label: Change text
prompt: Keep typeface, weight, tracking, and perspective. Replace the lettering with the original word HELLO. Lock glyph geometry.

label: Change ratio
prompt: Keep the subject. Reframe onto the Format canvas. Outpaint edges with matching scene. Empty of new lettering.

label: Face lock
prompt: Lock the reference face. Same identity, wardrobe, and eyeline. Change only what the prompt names. Original character only.

label: Outfit change
prompt: Keep face and body from the reference. Change clothing to an unmarked charcoal technical coat. Original character only.

label: Relight night
prompt: Keep the reference inventory. Relight as practical-lamp night interior. Warm pools, cool window rim.

label: Product packshot
prompt: Clean packshot of an unmarked ceramic mug on a sweep. Soft wrap light, sharp unmarked surfaces, empty of type.

label: YouTube thumbnail
prompt: YouTube thumbnail still. Large original character, one short original word, 16:9, high contrast, empty of real brands.

label: Quote card
prompt: Quote card still. Original line on a clean field. Strong type, empty background.

label: Sky replace
prompt: Keep the scene from the reference. Replace only the sky with a storm front and the light it casts.

label: Add object
prompt: Keep the reference scene. Add one unmarked brass lamp on the table with matching light and contact shadow.

label: Outpaint wide
prompt: Keep the reference center. Extend the canvas to Format size with matching architecture left and right.

label: Fix hands
prompt: Keep the reference. Correct extra fingers and melted hands only. Original character only.

label: Interior room
prompt: Architectural interior of a writing room. Window light, teak desk, unmarked shelves. Empty of signage.

label: Golden hour look
prompt: Golden-hour sidelight, long shadows, warm rim. Photoreal still of the prompted place. Empty of lettering.

label: Instagram post
prompt: Instagram 4:5 still. One original subject, clean background, empty of platform chrome and tiny type.

label: Relabel sign
prompt: Keep the sign object. Swap the written words to OPEN. Lock glyph geometry and perspective.

label: Wardrobe transfer
prompt: Keep the person in the first reference. Transfer wardrobe look from a second still if present, else an unmarked dark indigo-violet suede coat. Original characters only.

label: Empty of lettering
prompt: Keep the reference. Remove all lettering and reconstruct surfaces. Empty of marks.
